propositions: Bedrock LLM operations fail with 'no AWS region could be resolved' when only AWS_REGION environment variable is set, despite it being the standard region variable modern AWS tooling recognizes
botocore 1.43.62 does not consult AWS_REGION; the current resolution chain (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION → AWS_DEFAULT_REGION → profile) skips it entirely
The error message incorrectly documents AWS_REGION as non-functional rather than implementing explicit resolution in rebar's layer to work around botocore's quirk
Provider provenance has no region field today and cannot record which source resolved the Bedrock region

Resolution precedence must be implemented as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > boto3 profile fallback, with the resolved region passed explicitly to boto3.session.Session(region_name=...)
